notes: OCP is a synchronous-logic on-chip interface; there is no analog/lab calibration in the specification. Timing is closed by synthesis/STA, not by bench calibration. This layer is essentially N/A for the OCP contract.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Handshake timing closure
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the OCP phase handshakes (SCmdAccept / SDataAccept / MRespAccept) meet setup/hold at the OCP clock (an STA / timing-closure concern, not a lab-bench measurement).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: EnableClk gating correctness
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate that active OCP edges qualified by EnableClk behave correctly.
